stem: Glue Spark jobs sometimes suffer shuffle skew. The team wants Spark to detect and correct skewed partitions at runtime. Which statements are correct about adaptive execution-style capabilities?

options.label: A
options.body: Adaptive Query Execution can coalesce/optimize skewed shuffle partitions based on runtime stats

options.label: B
options.body: Enabling AQE-related settings can reduce manual salting for many skew cases

options.label: C
options.body: AQE requires disabling the Glue Data Catalog permanently

options.label: D
options.body: Skew is impossible on Parquet inputs

options.label: E
options.body: The only fix is always converting to CSV

explanation: AQE uses runtime statistics to mitigate skew; it does not require abandoning the catalog or changing to CSV.
